description: This file defines the EntityEcaAction class, which represents an action triggered by entity change events within the Apache OFBiz framework. It handles executing services synchronously or asynchronously based on XML configuration, with support for error handling, user impersonation, and result processing.

classes.name: EntityEcaAction
classes.description: Represents an entity event condition action, capable of executing associated services with configurable parameters such as mode, user context, and error handling.

methods.name: EntityEcaAction
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the action parameters from an XML element.

methods.name: getServiceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service to be invoked when the action runs.

methods.name: runAction
methods.description: Executes the configured service, handling synchronization mode, user impersonation, error handling, and updating the entity value as needed.
